about: Path (b), Zeki #5699: frozen settings of the small chat rows as v3.db players rows without play. Each settings object is the prepared late-entry player.json, unchanged.

settings.name: MiniCPM5-2B (on)
settings.note: openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B @ 42433e90dad95123ab87729fd7011e7110629556, BF16, on our GPU through vLLM v0.30.0 (vllm/vllm-openai:v0.30.0) in BF16, --generation-config auto; logic's server (small_models.py key minicpm5-2b, port 18614, bariton GPU 1, #5080/#5091; ours alone after turkce's 'done') or ours on the same port and name (tools/v3/late-smallchat/serve.sh). thinking on (enable_thinking true), no effort sent (reasoning_effort removed: template default); the letter is read after the reasoning from a prefilled Answer: (as Gemma 4 31B (on)); reasoning split by the server's vLLM reasoning parser qwen3 (it matters only for replies cut off before </think>: the letter is read from logprobs after the prefilled answer). Sampling: League 1's local chat rule, per request: temperature 1.0 from the chat client, everything else the server's default (generation_config.json via --generation-config auto, else vLLM neutral), no seed; it differs from logic's Logic & Math runs: logic sends temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, seed 0 (ours: the same temperature and top_p from generation_config.json; no seed). Output cap 32,768 tokens (the chat client default, as Qwen3.8-27B (on)). Up to 16 matches and 16 requests at once, League 1's rule for its local chat setups (the server is ours alone after turkce's 'done'). Late entry v the original League 1 table (tools/v3/late-smallchat; Zeki #5064/#5071/#5073; Main's decisions 12 Nov)
